title: A-B pair at rest, r0 = 8, T = 10: does one constant K fit the full approach?
pitch: Single A-B pair released at rest at separation 8 (centre (5,5), horizontal) and tracked for T = 10 at dt 0.005 (2000 samples, the limit). Our map shows point K estimates falling with r (about 9 at r 4 to 5, about 6 to 7 at r 8), but per-run errors are near 1 and a pooled constant-K fit is at the noise floor. A single long run gives the strongest r-dependence test because the displacement grows with T squared. Result discriminates constant K against separation-dependent K and sets the exponent question for the close-range claims.
